correctness.rationale: A CC density operator is diagonal in some product basis, and that basis refines eigenspaces of its two marginals; conversely a rank-one marginal spectral-refinement product resolution commuting with the state forces product-basis diagonality. For universal commutation, all rank-one product projectors inside each P_alpha tensor Q_beta block generate its full matrix algebra, whose commutant consists of scalars; cross-block terms vanish, giving rho=sum c_ab P_a tensor Q_b with nonnegative coefficients and the stated marginal trace constraints. Conversely that block scalar form commutes with all refinements. Two-qubit rho_cc=0.5(|00><00|+|11><11|) has both marginals I/2 but X-basis dephasing yields I/4; checked the exact matrix witness independently.
